system.biography:
SLOTVs.

The flotilla carries with it seven shuttles for when they need to go into atmosphere, such as Mars or Venus, or when larger ships are not permitted too close to a habitat. The shuttles of the fleet are all SLOTVs (p. 349, Eclipse Phase) that use metallic hydrogen for propulsion. All seven of the shuttles are kept in good working condition and carry enough supplies to keep a crew of eight alive for a month, though they are not intended to be away from regular maintenance for that long. Usually two shuttles are docked with The Stars Our Destination, two are docked with the Thoughtcrime, one on each of the barges, one on the Rig, and one in storage on Abstinence Only. Any member of the swarm can request use of the shuttles as a Moderate favor. However, the shuttles tend to be underused since most members of the fleet have little interest in leaving.

Source: Eclipse Phase The Stars Our Destination, p. 11.
